title: WINSPACE Japan original T1600 current frame specification recheck
notes: Rechecked 2026-09-25. The current regional manufacturer page for the original T1600 (not T1600 Ultra) publishes 700×32C maximum tire size and T1100+T1000 carbon with Kevlar reinforcement. 32C is a nominal tire-size limit, not a measured 32 mm internal clearance; the page does not select the retained mainland complete-bike trim.
